name: Portrait
source:
Main character attends a religious school. As a member of art club he has his hesitations sometimes. One day he reads a book and gets so much inspired by it that decides to make his new work with this book as a motif. Each day he works with girls on his work and each night he interacts with their hearts in his dreams.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公就读于一所宗教学校。身为美术社成员，他有时会对创作感到迷惘。一天，他读到一本书，深受启发，决定以书中内容为主题创作新作品。此后，他每天与女孩们共同完成作品，每晚则在梦中触及她们的内心。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
